categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and adjusts network reachability detection, AddrMan updates, and outbound peer connection logic.
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes in single-stack environments from wasting outbound connection attempts and AddrMan slots on unreachable networks. As noted in the PR description, 'In many network environments, IPv6 peers cannot be reached, which is currently not detected', causing nodes to make 'futile attempts to connect to them (e.g. feelers or network-specific connections)'.
